棚.meaning: An owl who collects things nails a plank between two limbs of her <part>tree</part> and lines it with treasures: buttons, a teaspoon, a snow globe with <part>twin moons</part> inside. Every night she dusts it with a wing. Every owl needs a <kanji>shelf</kanji>.
棚.on: Once a week the farmer below rinses it with his garden <sound>hose</sound>, and she hoots at him.
棚.kun: Her newest treasure is a <sound>ta</sound>co wrapped in <sound>na</sound>an.

駄.meaning: A <part>plump</part> pony refuses to walk to the fair, so the farmer ends up carrying the <part>horse</part> on his back, puffing up the hill with hooves dangling round his ears. The pony munches an apple the whole way. What a <kanji>burdensome</kanji> pet.
駄.on: A <sound>du</sound>ck hops onto the pony's head, adding to the load.

墓.meaning: At <part>sunset</part>, a retired robot digs a hole in the <part>soil</part> for his worn-out vacuum cleaner, plants a daisy on top and plays it a soft beep. It cleaned for forty years. It deserves a proper <kanji>grave</kanji>.
墓.on: Beside it he plants a tiny <sound>bo</sound>nsai tree to keep it company.
墓.kun: Then he plays a slow tune on a little <sound>ha</sound>rp, standing <sound>ca</sound>lm in the dusk.

項.meaning: A <part>rubber duck</part> writes its memoirs at a tiny <part>workbench</part> beside the bath, one squeaky line at a time. Every time the water ripples, it starts a fresh section about bubbles. The whole book is one-line chapters, each a new <kanji>paragraph</kanji>.
項.on: Between sections it nibbles the tip of an ice cream <sound>cone</sound>.
項.kun: It balances <sound>u</sound>don, <sound>na</sound>an and a toy <sound>jee</sound>p on the nape of its neck.

是.meaning: A fussy giant polishes his <part>giant boot</part> until it shines like the <part>sun</part>, sets it toes-first by the door, nudges it a hair to the left, then back. Only then does he smile. Everything must be <kanji>just so</kanji>.
是.on: He sprinkles lemon <sound>ze</sound>st on his porridge, exactly three flakes.
是.kun: On the doormat he sets a toy <sound>ko</sound>ala with a <sound>re</sound>d bow, and points at it: this one.

随.meaning: A <part>flag bearer</part> marches down a <part>ramp</part> onto a ferry, and behind her come forty ducklings, a goat and a man who just likes flags. Nobody knows where the ferry is going. They just <kanji>follow</kanji>.
随.on: The ducklings chase a rolling yu<sound>zu</sound> fruit, and an <sound>ee</sound>l slithers after them.
随.kun: Their <sound>ma</sound>ma waddles behind, then a goat with a sore <sound>knee</sound>, then a <sound>ma</sound>rching band.

邦.meaning: After years at sea, a sailor leaps off his boat, ties his <part>pennant</part> to the nearest <part>corn stalk</part> and hugs it. The farmer is baffled. But to the sailor, every row of corn means one thing: his <kanji>home country</kanji>.
邦.on: The farmer welcomes him with a blast from his garden <sound>hose</sound>.
邦.kun: His mum hands him a <sound>coo</sound>kie, and he drops to one <sound>knee</sound> to eat it.
